changelog: Yooka-Replaylee PopTracker v2.72 — Major Update
This release includes all improvements made since v2.71.1, focusing on improved location logic, collectible tracking, and updated visuals.
What's New
Progressive Pagie Door Logic: Corrected accessibility requirements for Glitterglaze Glacier (15), Moodymaze Marsh (35), Capital Cashino (55), and Galleon Galaxy (75).
Quill Tracking: Added world-colored quill icons that turn gray when collected, with individual completion tracking for grouped quills.
Galleon Galaxy: Fixed quill counters to display the number of remaining quills in each group.
IcyMetric Tower: Updated quill accessibility logic and collection tracking.
Golden Pagies: Updated all Pagie checks with the correct Golden Pagie artwork and grayscale completion states.
Pagie Pieces: Added new transparent artwork to all 40 Pagie Piece checks, including grayscale completion states.
Automatic Map Switching: Preserved automatic switching between all six maps, including returning to Hivory Towers.
General Improvements: Updated internal versioning and layout labels.
Installation
Download Yooka-Replaylee_PopTracker_v2.72.zip from the Assets section below and install it in PopTracker without extracting it.
Requirements: PopTracker 0.35.4 or later. Automatic map switching requires the updated Yooka-Replaylee MelonLoader Archipelago mod.
Automatic Updates
This release supports the automatic-update system. Once the release is indexed, compatible installations can detect v2.72 through the update feed.
Note: Package validation has passed; live gameplay testing is recommended.
v2.71.1 — Automatic World Switching
New Feature: Automatic Map Switching
PopTracker automatically switches maps when entering a new world.
Automatically returns to the Hivory Towers map when leaving a world.
Supports all six world maps.
Preserves existing item tracking, location checks, and map functionality.
Important: Automatic world switching requires the updated MelonLoader Archipelago mod from the main Yooka-Replaylee Archipelago page. Please update your MelonLoader mod to use this feature.
Requires PopTracker 0.35.4 or later.
## Yooka-Replaylee PopTracker 2.70.0
Download **Yooka-Replaylee_PopTracker_v2.70.0.zip** from Assets and drag it into PopTracker, or place it in your PopTracker packs folder without extracting it.
- Internal pack version and all resolution preset labels now match 2.70.0.
- Includes HD, Full HD, 1440p, 4K, and horizontal layouts.
- The pack points to the automatic release update feed.
- Retains the maps, checks, items, and Archipelago logic from the supplied working build.
Requires PopTracker 0.35.4 or later. Future published pack releases are added to the update feed automatically; PopTracker handles update checking and installation.
The archived original ZIP is the earlier 2.62.0 build retained for recovery. GitHub's Source code downloads are repository snapshots, not installable tracker packs.

Validation: ZIP integrity, JSON parsing, Lua syntax, referenced image/layout files, and update-feed checksum checks passed. Live gameplay and a real Archipelago connection have not been tested in this environment.
